The '''Nebula Hotel''' was a chain of [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] found throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar]].
